notes.title: Patch v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.0 Patch notes:
- Performance optimization: Changed the internal rendering technique for all props and characters that should have better performance and provide a more stable frame-rate for most systems.
- Fixed some obscure bugs.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.7
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.7 Patch notes:
 - Added a screen shake slider to the options menu. Screen shake can now be eliminated or doubled.
 - Slightly improved startup time when first loading the game.

notes.title: New chapters in development!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, I really want to thank everyone for buying the game and supporting us! As some of you may know, this game had a fairly rocky development, which I wrote in more detail about [url=http://nicotuason.com/10years.html]here[/url]. Long story short, the game was originally planned to have 13 chapters, but because of the difficulties faced we had to cut the game in half and launch with only 6 chapters.

Based on everyone's reviews (if you left one then thank you!), it seems the biggest complaint that people have is the game's length. I am announcing now that we are working to restore chapter 7 - 13. We will be releasing the chapters as a free update to everyone who has bought the game.

I am planning to complete the first batch of chapters (7 - 9) sometime in August - September, and the next batch (10 - 13) TBA.

If you would like to receive updates and progress about the new chapters, please follow the game's [url=https://twitter.com/lithiumcity]twitter[/url] account and my [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQgI7Nf4i-5PM_rJv9lOmuQ]youtube[/url] channel. We will also be posting updates on this forum.

Lastly, it will really help us out if you spread the word about the game to your friends, leave a review, or post on the forum your feedback and suggestions for the new content.

Time to get back to work!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5BNBjFW.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch v1.0.6
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.6 Patch notes:
 - Added extra telegraph to the final boss' multi-javelin attack (Javelins now glow and move backwards when about to launch)
 - Fixed a bug where the player would end up outside the playable area

notes.title: OST Available on June 29, 2020
notes.notes: Hey everyone! John has been hard at work remastering the game's music for the OST. It will be available for purchase on June 29, 2020 for $4.99 (regional prices vary). The OST contains 17 tracks in high quality mp3 and FLAC formats.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.5 Patch notes:
- Made some balancing changes to Chapter 6-1 and 6-2 (gunship levels) such as adding a laser pointer to the gunship when it is about to fire, and tweaking the bullet hit detection.

notes.title: Addressing performance issues and crashes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! First of all thank you for playing the game! I've received some reports of performance issues and crashes. I'm really sorry if this affects you and I am actively trying to fix the issue. If you are affected by these, I've uploaded a beta version that runs on DirectX 11 (The base game runs on DirectX 9).

To access the DirectX 11 Beta, please take the following steps:
[olist]
[*] Right-click the game in your library.
[*] Click "Properties".
[*] Click on the "Betas" tab on the top of the window.
[*] Select "beta - DirectX 11 version" from the dropdown.
[*] After the game updates play the game from your library.
[/olist]

Hopefully this resolves issue. If not, please post in the forum so I can address it.

Thank you,
- Nico

notes.title: Game Launch!
notes.notes: After almost 6 years of development, Lithium City version 1.0.0 is finally released! Thank you to everyone for your unending support and patience. Please enjoy!
